items.title: Who keeps the judgment when AI carries the rules? Microsoft HVE Core in practice
items.description: Microsoft HVE Core is the open-source reference implementation of Hypervelocity Engineering, the governed, agentic software lifecycle for GitHub Copilot from Microsoft’s Industry Solutions Engineering team. An architect’s view of what it gets right, which of its design decisions stand on their own, and how a Microsoft 365 team should bring it in.
items.author: Arindam Choudhury
